loading_tips (TnOnlineGameSettingsBase.E: Thermo Mines will seek their target.
Remember to reload your weapon after every fire fight.
The longer the Plasma Cannon is charged, the more damage it causes.
The Scatter Blaster is most effective at close range.
Energon Grenades create a healing aura when they explode.
Use EMP Grenades to disorient your enemies.
Bring on the pain train. In truck form, take out enemies using your Ram ability.
The Thermo Rocket Launcher can only lock-on to vehicles.
The Whirlwind Ability is a devastating melee attack capable of hitting multiple targets.
Do a Barrel Roll while in jet form to avoid getting hit.
Use the Energon Repair Ray to heal spawned Sentries.
Use Fine Aim for precision targeting.
You can remotely detonate grenades launched by the Magma Frag Launcher.
The X12 Scrapmaker winds up slowly before unleashing its full power.
If you run out of ammo for your Robot weapons, don't forget about your Vehicle weapons.
If an enemy gets too close for comfort, bash them with a melee attack.
Double jump in Robot form by pressing the jump button a second time while in the air.
Cancel certain Abilities like Barrier and Cloaking by pressing the Ability button after activation.
The Hover Ability increases all weapon damage.
While using the Hover Ability, you can press the Jump button at any time to cancel it.
Warcry buffs your teammates with increased armor and damage.
Use the Cloaking Ability to turn invisible for a brief time.
Continuously firing your weapons makes them less accurate. Try firing in bursts.
The Energon Repair Ray is a beam weapon that heals teammates and damages enemies.
Grab an Overshield for increased armor.
Jumping decreases the accuracy of your weapons.
